description: Lists posts from the Cotal build log (blog), newest first, with cursor pagination. Use it to browse what the team has shipped or written recently. Returns posts (slug, title, dek, date, author, URLs) and next_cursor; pass next_cursor back for the following page.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call.

name: cotal_list_posts

next_cursor.description: Pass to the next call; null on the last page.

slug.description: Post slug; pass it to cotal_get_post.

title: List build-log posts
